about: Which dates each WXPredict question has been scored on, so no rule is tested on dates it was found, tuned or looked at on. Every result in data/eval/wxpredict is registered here exactly once; tests/test_wxpredict_exposure_ledger.py checks it. A new result is registered in the same PR that commits it, and untouched_from moves past every date scored. Written 11 Oct 2026 (the Codex action plan of 11 Oct, section 2: one exposure ledger).
untouched_note: No WXPredict model, rule or control has been scored on an event date from 5 Oct (every result below ends by 4 Oct, the table's newest date). Data volumes after 4 Oct were counted (trade prints a day, R46) without outcomes or prices being scored.

results_built_on.note: every model result of 11 Oct was made on a table rebuilt from 11 Oct's sources (47 cities; R47), not the recorded one; build_table.py --recorded rebuilds the recorded one

sealed_test: WXPREDICT_BUILD.md section 4 sealed 1 Sep - 4 Oct 2026 for WXPredict v1 until G4. From 11 Oct (Hassan: 'DO NOT FREEZE ... WE NEED TO BUILD A SOLID SYSTEM') the research models below were scored out of sample on those dates by walk-forward and at the real asks, so 1 Sep - 4 Oct is no longer an untouched test for any WXPredict model. The untouched dates start 5 Oct.
